title: Bikri bahut, par bacha kya?
caption:
Mahina achchha gaya, par jeb mein kitna aaya? Aap apna bacha hua paisa kaise nikaalte hain? 👇
ScoreMyBiz, 30 din muft: link in bio.
linkedin_text: A short illustrated story in Hindi about a garment shop owner who opens a profit report built from his own entries and sees sales, the cost of goods, running costs and what he kept. It is a view of his book, not statutory accounts. ScoreMyBiz is free for 30 days on Google Play.

art.style: Warm hand-painted Indian storybook illustration, soft gouache and watercolour texture, golden-hour lighting, rich detailed everyday Indian settings, expressive faces, gentle nostalgic mood.

cast.Harish: Harish is a man in his mid forties who runs a small garment shop, with a moustache, a light blue kurta and a measuring tape around his neck.
cast.Meena: Meena is Harish's wife, a woman in her forties in a green saree with a warm smile.

scenes.vo: दिवाली के बाद हरीश की कपड़ों की दुकान ख़ूब चली।
scenes.sub: Diwali ke baad Harish ki kapdon ki dukaan khoob chali.
scenes.art: Harish in a small garment shop with folded shirts and sarees on shelves, several customers browsing, festive lights.

scenes.vo: मीना ने पूछा, इस महीने कितना बचा?
scenes.sub: Meena ne poochha, is mahine kitna bacha?
scenes.art: Meena standing by the counter with a tiffin box, asking Harish a question, he looks up from folding a shirt.

scenes.vo: हरीश बोला, बिक्री तो बहुत हुई है।
scenes.sub: Harish bola, bikri toh bahut hui hai.
scenes.art: Harish spreading his hands proudly over a pile of bills on the counter.

scenes.vo: पर माल का पैसा, किराया, बिजली, सब उसी में से गया था।
scenes.sub: Par maal ka paisa, kiraaya, bijli, sab usi mein se gaya tha.
scenes.art: Harish counting on his fingers with a thoughtful frown, a rent receipt and an electricity bill on the counter.

scenes.vo: असल में हाथ में क्या आया, उसे ख़ुद नहीं पता था।
scenes.sub: Asal mein haath mein kya aaya, use khud nahi pata tha.
scenes.art: Harish scratching his head, Meena raising an eyebrow with a small smile.

scenes.vo: उसने स्कोर माय बिज़ में मुनाफ़े की रिपोर्ट खोली।
scenes.sub: Usne ScoreMyBiz mein munaafe ki report kholi.
scenes.art: Harish holding his phone, Meena leaning in to look over his shoulder.

scenes.vo: ऊपर बिक्री, नीचे माल की लागत, और बीच में जो बचा।
scenes.sub: Upar bikri, neeche maal ki laagat, aur beech mein jo bacha.

scenes.vo: फिर ख़र्चे अलग अलग, और आख़िर में जो सच में रखा।
scenes.sub: Phir kharche alag alag, aur aakhir mein jo sach mein rakha.

scenes.vo: यह सब उसकी अपनी लिखी एंट्री से बना था।
scenes.sub: Yeh sab uski apni likhi entry se bana tha.
scenes.art: Harish nodding slowly at his phone with understanding, shelves of cloth behind.

scenes.vo: बिक्री बड़ी थी, पर बचत उससे काफ़ी छोटी।
scenes.sub: Bikri badi thi, par bachat usse kaafi chhoti.
scenes.art: Harish and Meena looking at each other, he gives a sheepish smile.

scenes.vo: अब उसे पता है अगला माल कितना उठाना है।
scenes.sub: Ab use pata hai agla maal kitna uthaana hai.
scenes.art: Harish writing a short list in a small notebook with a calm, decided face, Meena pouring tea.

scenes.vo: आपको पता है इस महीने आपने सच में कितना रखा?
scenes.sub: Aapko pata hai is mahine aapne sach mein kitna rakha?
scenes.art: Close-up of Harish smiling at the viewer, colourful folded clothes softly blurred behind.

scenes.vo: स्कोर माय बिज़। तीस दिन मुफ़्त।
